SUBSCRIPTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review each workspace subscription, selected plan, current billing period, and payment status.
PLANS_DESCRIPTION: Review plan history and which plan version new workspaces can choose.
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Billing records aren't available right now. Try again. If the problem continues, keep this page open when asking for help.
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Ask an Instance Owner to review your Platform permissions.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no billing records to show.
FILTERED_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Adjust or clear the current filters.
SUBSCRIPTION_DETAIL_EMPTY: Select a subscription to inspect its plan, period, and recovery state.
DEACTIVATE_PLAN_DESCRIPTION: New workspaces won't be able to choose {{plan}} after it is deactivated. Existing subscriptions and history stay unchanged.
CREATE_PLAN_DESCRIPTION: Create a plan first, then add a version.
CREATE_DRAFT_DESCRIPTION: Start a new version for {{plan}}. Review its terms before publishing.
EDIT_DRAFT_DESCRIPTION: Update the draft terms for {{plan}} before publishing.
TERMS_JSON_DESCRIPTION: Enter the plan terms. We check them before saving this version.
TERMS_JSON_INVALID: Plan terms must be valid JSON.
ACTION_ERROR: The service has not confirmed this billing change. Nothing is treated as updated.
PAYMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Review signed payment-service events and check eligible failed events.
PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_DESCRIPTION: Event records come from the payment service. Raw data isn't shown.
CREDITS_DESCRIPTION: Review current workspace AI credit balances.
CREDITS_LOOKUP_DESCRIPTION: Enter a workspace identifier to load its current billing details.
CREDITS_BALANCE_DESCRIPTION: Review the current balance and make a recorded adjustment when a correction is needed.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_DESCRIPTION: Review this grant or correction. The system checks the current balance and reserved credits before saving it.
CREDIT_DELTA_DESCRIPTION: Use a positive whole number to grant credits, or a negative whole number to expire or correct them.
EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_DESCRIPTION: Enter a support case, payment review, or another reference that explains this change.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_DELTA_INVALID: Enter a non-zero whole-number AI credit change.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter the reason for this adjustment.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Enter a reference that supports this adjustment.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_PERMISSION_ERROR: You do not have permission to adjust AI credits
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_STALE_ERROR: The Credit balance changed after you opened this adjustment
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_RESERVED_ERROR: This adjustment would consume reserved AI credits
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_ERROR: The Credit adjustment was not confirmed
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_UNCHANGED: The service didn't record this adjustment. Reload the current balance before changing the request.
CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT_RESULT: The balance changed from {{before}} to {{after}}. The current record version is {{revision}}.
CONFIGURATION_DESCRIPTION: Review payment-service setup and anything still missing.
PROVIDER_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: See separately whether the service is configured, payment notifications are verified, and the connection is available.
CONFIGURATION_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE: Arclayer Admin can show payment-service status, but it cannot change or test those settings yet.
SIMULATOR_DESCRIPTION: The payment simulator is for development and testing only. Every action still follows the normal payment recording process.
SIMULATOR_REJECTION: The payment simulator is unavailable. Check the test environment configuration.
PAYMENT_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTION: Set the rules for how failed payments are handled automatically.
EDIT_PAYMENT_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTION: Update the automatic rules used after a payment fails. Changes apply to future recovery attempts.
PAYMENT_RECOVERY_RULES_DESCRIPTION: This advanced configuration controls what happens after a payment fails. Review it carefully before saving.
PAYMENT_RECOVERY_JSON_INVALID: Payment recovery rules must be valid JSON.
PAYMENT_CORRECTION_DESCRIPTION: Record the key details returned by the payment service for manual review. This does not directly change AI credits or payment records.
PAYMENT_CORRECTION_INVALID: Enter complete payment details and a refund amount of zero or more.
PAYMENT_CORRECTION_ERROR: The correction record was not saved.
SUBSCRIPTIONS_SEARCH: Search workspace, plan, or subscription ID
SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Choose a lifecycle action after reviewing the current period and payment state.
PAYMENT_CORRECTION_REASON_PLACEHOLDER: Explain why this record needs a correction
REFUND_DESCRIPTION: Request a full refund for this eligible top-up. The original payment evidence stays unchanged.
REFUND_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for the refund.
REFUND_REASON_PLACEHOLDER: Explain why the refund is needed
TRANSITION_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Review a plan change before scheduling it. You can also cancel a scheduled change with its transition ID.
TARGET_REVISION_PLACEHOLDER: Paste the target plan revision ID
EFFECTIVE_AT_PLACEHOLDER: Choose when the change should start
RETAINED_ASSIGNMENTS_PLACEHOLDER: Assignment IDs to keep, separated by commas (optional)
TRANSITION_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Enter a target revision, start time, and a valid subscription revision.
TRANSITION_CANCEL_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Enter a transition ID and a valid transition revision.
TRANSITION_PREVIEW_READY: The plan change preview is ready. Review it before scheduling.
TRANSITION_PREVIEW_ERROR: The plan change preview could not be created.
TRANSITION_SCHEDULED: The plan change has been scheduled.
TRANSITION_SCHEDULE_ERROR: The plan change could not be scheduled.
TRANSITION_CANCELED: The scheduled plan change has been canceled.
TRANSITION_CANCEL_ERROR: The scheduled plan change could not be canceled.
PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_DESCRIPTION: Choose the payment service and replace credentials. Existing secrets are never shown again.
PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_ERROR: The payment provider configuration was not saved.
PROVIDER_SECRET_DESCRIPTION: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
WEBHOOK_SECRET_DESCRIPTION: Leave blank to keep the current webhook secret.
WEBHOOK_SECRET_PLACEHOLDER: Paste a new webhook signing secret
EXTERNAL_PRICE_ID_PLACEHOLDER: Paste the price ID from the payment service
